text: RAISED BY codex-storymodel4s-scout as a carrier check before editing, and it is correct: the chief ruled that non-content interview units are INELIGIBLE, and Estimate cannot represent that. Estimate is a two-armed enum - Observed(value, credence) | Missing(reason) - with no Ineligible case. MetricObservation (Ineligible | Observed | Missing) has the right shape but lives in package storymodel4s.bench, is embed-bench-local and JVM-only, so interview cannot depend on it. TWO MODULES HAVE NOW INDEPENDENTLY NEEDED THE THREE-WAY DISTINCTION, which is the evidence it belongs in the portable vocabulary rather than being copied a third time. BLAST RADIUS MEASURED BY THE CHIEF BEFORE PRESCRIBING: adding an arm to Estimate touches 31 match sites across 8 files in 6 modules - align (wire.scala, cost.scala), codec (sidecar.scala, features.scala), embed-bench, features, laws, view - and 26 files reference ScoreEstimate/Estimate. Three of those modules are held by active actors. THEREFORE NOT NOW and NOT smuggled into an interview bug fix; this is its own deliberate bead, scheduled when capacity allows. REJECTED INTERIM, and the reason matters: representing ineligibility as Missing(Custom(ns, "not-applicable")) would be distinguishable but would force every coverage computation to special-case a reason string to exclude it from the denominator - a convention the consumer must know, which is exactly the class of thing ADR 0003 exists to eliminate (support travels WITH the estimate, not beside it). Better to leave the distinction unexpressed than to express it as a convention.
